leave: Employees are entitled to 12 casual leaves and 10 sick leaves every year.
sick leave: Employees can avail 10 sick leaves with medical proof if necessary.
salary: Salary is credited on the last working day of every month.
work from home: Employees are allowed to work remotely twice a week with approval.
office timing: Office timings are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM from Monday to Friday.
dress code: Employees are expected to wear professional formal attire.
holiday: Public holidays are provided according to the official company calendar.
overtime: Overtime payment is applicable only after manager approval.
internship: Interns must maintain a minimum attendance of 85 percent.
attendance: Employees should maintain regular attendance during working hours.
probation: The probation period for new employees is 6 months.
resignation: Employees must provide a 30-day notice period before resignation.
insurance: Health insurance benefits are available for all full-time employees.
promotion: Promotions are based on performance reviews and managerial evaluation.
